Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> tu;
Description:
std::uint8_t optinal member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined tu (avtp_timestamp
uncertain) 1 bit header field.
The value range for version shall be:
0x00...0x01 : valid
0x02...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set value according the current state of the
corresponding global time base, if it is not provided by the application.

protected
